summary: The Gates Cambridge Scholarship, from the Gates Cambridge Trust, supports postgraduate study at the University of Cambridge in any subject. It is for applicants to a Cambridge postgraduate course for 2027/28 entry. In the international round, for applicants other than US citizens resident in the US, complete applications including references are due by the course's deadline.
highlights: You must be applying for a postgraduate course at the University of Cambridge for 2027/28 entry.
The international round is for applicants other than US citizens resident in the US.
Complete applications, including references, are due by 23:59 GMT on your course's deadline.
Deadline: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027, depending on the course.
